speaker: Doctor
text: When did the right leg weakness and unsteady gait first begin, and did they start suddenly or gradually? Also, have you experienced any headaches, vision changes, or seizures?

speaker: Patient
text: 44-year-old male. The patient's daughter reports a 1-week history of right leg weakness, unsteady gait, and multiple falls. Over the past 6 months, the patient has been increasingly forgetful, losing his way on familiar routes and facing difficulties operating simple kitchen appliances. He has also been paranoid, agitated, and restless recently.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any history of HIV infection, recent travel to endemic areas, or exposure to pork products? I also need to know if you have experienced any recent weight loss or night sweats.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Right leg weakness and unsteady gait. I also have Forgetfulness, Paranoid and agitated behavior, Difficulty in using kitchen appliances.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you had any recent headaches, fever, or neck stiffness, and do you have any known history of cancer or immune suppression? REQUEST TEST: MRI_Brain

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Disseminated, nonenhancing white matter lesions with no mass effect.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have a history of HIV or other conditions causing significant immunosuppression? I also need to know if you have experienced any recent weight loss or night sweats. REQUEST TEST: HIV_Status

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Positive, CD4+ Count: 56/μL, HIV Viral Load: > 100,000 copies/mL

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the positive HIV status with severe immunosuppression and the specific MRI findings, I need to confirm the presence of JC virus. REQUEST TEST: CSF_JCV_PCR

speaker: Doctor
text: With negative CSF JCV PCR and no mass effect, Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy is unlikely, so I suspect an alternative HIV-related opportunistic infection. REQUEST TEST: CSF_Cytology_and_Viral_Panel

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the disseminated white matter lesions, severe immunosuppression, and negative workup for PML and typical viral encephalitides, I suspect Toxoplasmosis despite the lack of enhancement, or potentially HIV-associated neurocognitive disorder with an atypical presentation. REQUEST TEST: Serum_Toxoplasma_IgG

speaker: Doctor
text: The positive Toxoplasma IgG indicates prior exposure, but the lack of ring-enhancing lesions on MRI makes active toxoplasmic encephalitis unlikely. Given the severe immunosuppression and disseminated white matter disease, I need to rule out Primary CNS Lymphoma or other etiologies. REQUEST TEST: CSF_FLOW_CYTOMETRY

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the disseminated white matter lesions, severe immunosuppression, and exclusion of PML, Toxoplasmosis, and Lymphoma, I suspect HIV-associated vacuolar myelopathy or advanced HIV encephalitis. REQUEST IMAGES: MRI_Brain_With_Contrast

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Known history of HIV, hypertension, and type 2 diabetes mellitus. Noncompliance with medications for over 2 years. Social history: Information not provided

speaker: Doctor
text: The clinical picture of progressive cognitive decline, behavioral changes, and motor symptoms in the context of severe HIV immunosuppression, combined with MRI showing diffuse white matter disease without mass effect and negative workup for PML, Toxoplasmosis, and Lymphoma, is classic for HIV-associated dementia. DIAGNOSIS READY: HIV-associated dementia (HIV encephalopathy)
